beats: [d:intrigue][sfx:boom][act:hushed, wonder]In the middle of a sea of sand in Arabia, ancient human footprints walk beside the tracks of ^elephants.
[d:tension][act:the twist, leaning in][tune:fall]Down to the shore of a lake that no longer ^exists.

[d:calm][act:plain, orienting]This is the Nefud desert@noun, in northern Saudi ^Arabia: dunes, as far as the eye can ^see. [act:steady, factual]In {2017|twenty seventeen}, researchers found an ancient lakebed there, crossed by ^tracks.

[d:build][go:3|0][act:counting, amused]Three hundred and seventy-six ^footprints in all. [act:ticking them off][tune:level]Among the ones that can be named: a hundred and seven ^camels, forty-three ^elephants. [p:0.93][act:the reveal, warm][tune:fall]And seven, made by ^people.

[d:build][act:curious, the method][tune:rise]So how old are ^they? [act:explaining, a simple picture]The prints were pressed into one layer of ^mud, with other layers above and ^below. [p:0.93][act:precise]The layer below is about a hundred and twenty-one thousand years ^old. [p:0.93][act:precise]The one above, about a hundred and twelve ^thousand. [act:explaining, clear]So the prints sit in between, like a letter slipped between two dated pages of a ^diary. [act:warm, vivid]Back then, Arabia was ^green again: lakes, grass, and animals moving ^in.
[d:aside][act:gentle, a small smile]Two or three people seem to have stopped at the water for a ^drink. [act:light][tune:fall]And then they moved ^on.

[d:build][act:building, precise]At Jebel ^Faya, in Sharjah, on the far side of the peninsula, stone tools go back about a hundred and twenty-five thousand years, with older layers ^below. [act:the point, clear][tune:fall]So Arabia wasn't a ^wall. [act:the image, warm]It was a ^door: it opened when the land turned green, and closed when the desert@noun came ^back.

[d:reveal][act:the crux, slower]But here's the ^catch. [act:precise][tune:level]No human ^bones. [act:precise][tune:fall]No ^DNA. [act:fair, the challenger's case]So who walked here is ^inferred: worked out from clues, not ^seen.

[d:build][act:a caveat, gentle]And most people outside Africa today descend from a much ^later wave, about fifty-five thousand years ago. [act:honest, open]Whether the lake walkers' family line ^survived, nobody can yet ^say.

[d:verdict][p:0.95][act:weighing it, even][tune:rise]Our own species, in Arabia, a hundred and twenty thousand years ago? [act:the verdict, measured][tune:fall]^*Plausible*. [act:fair]The prints are ^real, and so are their ^dates.
[d:tension][p:0.93][act:inviting, warm]A single bone, by one of those old lakes, could tell us who they ^were. [act:the last word, warm][tune:fall]Until then, the walkers still need a ^name.
